# Knowledge Agents

> Knowledge Agents is a no-code platform for building AI chatbots and AI chat pages ("Knowledge Agents") that are trained on your own content. Unlike basic chatbots, a Knowledge Agent both **answers customer questions 24/7** from your knowledge and **takes real actions** on the customer's behalf — such as booking meetings, creating support tickets, checking order status, processing returns, qualifying leads, and handing off to a human when needed.

## What a Knowledge Agent is

A **Knowledge Agent** is an AI assistant that you create by uploading your content (documents, websites, help centers, PDFs, FAQs) and connecting your tools. It can be deployed two ways:

1. **Chat widget** — an embeddable bubble that lives on any website with a single `<script>` tag.
2. **Chat page** — a standalone, shareable, SEO-friendly web page (its own URL) that answers questions and runs actions, with no website required.

Knowledge Agents use Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so answers are grounded in your source content with citations, reducing hallucinations. They support leading models including GPT-4o, Claude, and Gemini.

## Key facts

- **Category:** Conversational AI / AI customer support agent platform (no-code).
- **Primary use cases:** customer support automation, ticket deflection, lead generation, e-commerce assistance, employee/internal knowledge, onboarding.
- **Differentiator:** action-taking ("agentic") capabilities, not just Q&A. Agents can call APIs and run workflows (book, create, look up, update, route).
- **Time to launch:** typically under 5 minutes from first upload to an embedded, working agent.
- **Data sources:** PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, website crawling, help-center import, Notion, sitemaps, and pasted text.
- **Deployment:** website widget, standalone chat page, or API.
- **Pricing:** Free ($0), Hobby ($19/mo), Standard ($99/mo), Unlimited ($399/mo). Free plan requires no credit card.
- **Security:** encryption in transit and at rest; customer data is not used to train foundation models.

## The Knowledge Suite (product lineup)

- **Knowledge Bar** — turns any website or application into an AI application via an embedded answer bar.
- **Knowledge Bubble** — a virtual agent visitors talk to on your website; answers, captures leads, and takes actions.
- **Knowledge Page** — a collaborative content workspace teams publish as a standalone, shareable AI page.
